description: Run ONE pipeline module for a project (context is injected from upstream modules + crew agents). SYNCHRONOUS and LLM-heavy: light modules return in seconds; heavy ones can exceed ~55s and then time out (504) — run those in the FilmLab web app instead. Pass an invalid module name to get the list of valid module keys. Returns the module output.
